verdicts.quote: the head of the queue is booked at once when a spot opens. No accept/decline step and no hold timer.

**first-come-first-served** by the server's join time; ties break by entry creation order. … priority tiers or paid skip-the-line … a new staff roster/reordering view). They are out of scope until requested.
with no limit on the number of sessions waited for. … overlap is handled by the booking rules at promotion.
verdicts.missing: The first promotion has no stated effect on the other waitlist entry. The overlap rule that would govern its later promotion is unconfirmed.

verdicts.quote: No accept/decline step and no hold timer. … Can't make it? Cancel from My bookings. … The existing eligibility, credit and cancellation-window rules stay authoritative
verdicts.missing: Automatic booking eliminates the decline step. The spec leaves unstated whether missing the promoted class or cancelling late incurs the usual attendance penalty.

verdicts.quote: Cancelling member → Server `cancel`; … Server serialises on the session, removes the booking, runs the promotion procedure (head → booking + PROMOTED, or SKIPPED), records notices, commits, and answers the canceller (synchronous).

**channel the app already uses for booking confirmations**, else an in-app notice. … booked into {class name} on {date} at {time}. … failure never undoes a promotion … a delivery retry does not create a second record
confirmed never exceeds capacity; each opened spot goes to exactly one member … Alice and Bob cancel simultaneously → W1 and W2 promoted, each once.
(book, cancel, join, leave, capacity change, close) behave as if executed one at a time. … no member holds two entries or an entry plus a booking for the same session … if run second
taking payment or a credit at join time. … Promotion writes a normal confirmed booking through the same booking creation path as a direct booking (including its rules).
verdicts.missing: Charging at join is excluded. The spec leaves the charge timing for a promoted booking and the disposition of the entry and seat after a declined charge unspecified.

verdicts.quote: the 10th entry is accepted; the 11th is refused … `Waitlist full` disabled | `Class full · 10 on waitlist`
If the existing app has an earlier booking cutoff (G-3) the waitlist uses it. … a spot opened at `now >= start` promotes nobody.
verdicts.missing: The default permits promotion until class start. A cutoff strictly before start depends on the existing booking window, whose closing time is unconfirmed.

verdicts.quote: staff raise the capacity (opens k = new − old spots). A reduced capacity or a raised one that leaves the session still full opens nothing. … k spots promote at most k members.
when a session is cancelled, all its WAITING entries become CLOSED(class_cancelled) with the CLOSED notice (R-6).

a new waitlist-entry record (member, session, state, join time, state-change time, reason). … Position and waiting count are derived, never stored … position = 1 + WAITING entries with earlier join order; computed on read.
WAITING → CLOSED(class_started); no notice | reported CLOSED even before stored … Terminal entries are deleted 90 days after session start (A-7).
no response contains another member's name, ID or email, only the caller's position and the count.
a waitlist entry holds member ID, session ID, state, join time, state-change time and reason. … staff access follows the existing staff access to bookings (no new staff view is added, out of scope).
verdicts.missing: Staff read access is inherited. The spec gives no staff action for manually promoting or removing a waiting member and no defined way for staff to review who was promoted when.

verdicts.quote: records notices, commits, and answers the canceller (synchronous). … the cancel response already includes the promotion result, so the promoted booking is visible on the next read after the cancel response
the existing class list/detail, capacity display and Book action for classes that are not full … existing booking records and flows are unchanged
wherever a class is shown with its booking action (list and detail) … `Join waitlist` and `Class full · no waitlist yet` … A successful join creates a WAITING entry at the back of the queue
